hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.missing: KDOT prices people, not crashes (Crash Facts: each K, A, B, C person adds a cost; $11,900 per PDO crash, 2019 dollars); CrashIQ prices one cost per crash level, so there is no per-crash KDOT figure to print (shared fix proposed in research_notes/ks-2026-11-08/shared-fixes.md)

rules: per person: each possibly (C), non-disabling (B), disabling (A) or fatally (K) injured person adds that amount to the crash
a crash with nobody hurt costs $11,900
basis: FHWA-SA-17-01 adjusted to Kansas (2019 CPI, earnings, 2018 income, 2019 Kansas crashes)
not used by CrashIQ yet: the profile prices per crash

statewide_rates.missing: KDOT's Crash Facts gives all-roads rates only (2023: 187.95 crashes per 100 million vehicle miles, p. 1), not by facility type, and CrashIQ has no Kansas traffic counts

screening.state_method: crash frequency, crash rate, critical rate, EPDO, excess expected crashes with EB and level of service of safety (KDOT 2025 HSIP report, Intersection program, pp. 8-9)

min_years.missing: not stated in the KDOT documents read (2025 HSIP report, 2023 Crash Facts)

spf_calibration.missing: KDOT says it has its own calibration factors and SPFs (Kansas Register 2026-05-07, RFP 106-P-1815-27) but doesn't publish them; no SPF engine in CrashIQ
